data.one_liner: A package to help writing custom linters.
data.what_it_does: custom_lint_builder is associated with custom_lint for defining custom_lint plugins. It allows plugin authors to access classes such as LintRule or Assist.
use_when: You are developing a custom_lint plugin
You want to define custom lints or code assists for Dart
avoid_when: You just want to use existing custom lints
You want to expose new utilities for plugin authors without making a custom_lint plugin (use custom_lint_core instead)
strengths: Enables the creation of custom lints and assists
data.setup_notes: Depending on custom_lint_builder will tell custom_lint that your package is a plugin and try to run it.
